meta.title: Silica Station

subtitle.detail: Command a lunar outpost and make critical decisions to keep your crew alive.

location.detail: The Sea of Tranquility, where Apollo 11 landed.

moonDirtNote.short: Moon dirt (regolith) is your primary resource for building and repairs.
moonDirtNote.detail: Lunar regolith can be used to build shields, generate oxygen, and repair equipment.

powerAtZeroRule.short: If power reaches 0, oxygen scrubbers shut down and crew health drops rapidly.
powerAtZeroRule.detail: Always maintain backup power or reduce consumption to avoid catastrophic failure.

meta.darkPeriodNote: The lunar night lasts 14 Earth days and solar panels generate no power.

night_soon.short: Night is coming! Solar power will stop.
night_soon.detail: Prepare batteries and reduce power consumption before the 14-day lunar night begins.

delay_soon.detail: The resupply ship is running behind schedule. Conserve resources carefully.

flare_soon.detail: A dangerous solar flare is approaching. Build shields and shelter the crew.

leak_soon.detail: A micrometeorite has punctured the hull. Patch it quickly before oxygen runs out.

situation.short: Your crew has found a deposit of fine lunar regolith.
situation.detail: This moon dirt can be processed into building materials, radiation shielding, and oxygen.

label.detail: Send a rover to collect moon dirt.

why.short: Gathers raw materials for future construction.
why.detail: Regolith is essential for building shields and generating oxygen.

delayedReason.detail: The collected dirt is processed and added to your radiation shielding.

flareHit.detail: Radiation damages the crew and equipment.

resupplyArrived.detail: Fresh supplies and new crew members have arrived.

powerZeroPenalty.short: Power at zero! Emergency protocols engaged.
powerZeroPenalty.detail: Life support systems are running on backup power. Crew health is at risk.
